zipper.Type: A mechanical fastening device used to secure fabric by interlocking teeth
zipper.Color: Varies depending on application, commonly black, silver, or red
zipper.Composition: Composed of interlocking teeth made from plastic or metal, with a slider mechanism
zipper.Relative Location: Attached along the seam or edge of clothing or packaging
zipper.Orientation: Horizontal, running parallel to the edge of the fabric
zipper.Connection or Attachments: Connected to fabric via a zipper pull and slider, allowing opening and closing
